blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 131 classrooms will be built for last-mile schools next year, following the passage of a law that institutionalizes support for geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas (Gida), according to a lawmaker on Tuesday. During the House sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed budget of the Department of Education (DepEd) for next year, Akbayan Rep. Percival Cendaña asked Davao de Oro Rep. Maricar Zamora about the proposed budget for last-mile schools. Zamora, the agency’s budget sponsor, answered queries from her fellow lawmakers.
